followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified explanatory task — explain a defined economics concept and its concrete applications across three named areas (pricing, promotions, menu choices). It has clear completion criteria and isn't open-ended invention, which fits Avocet's preferred task profile well.

The query also carries a slightly impatient, critical tone ("don't ramble like usual," "this time"). Willet self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, so this mildly hostile framing cuts against routing there. Avocet's preference slopes for tone are near zero, so it's unbothered by it.

Capability-wise the two models are effectively tied on the relevant dimensions (the eval differences here are within variance), so the deciding factors were task fit and tone — both pointing to Avocet.
